metadata.title: SQL TO ActiveDirectory
metadata.description: This Script will query Informationen based on the Query Provided from ConfidentialTable or any Sql Table and then Populate it to the Active-Directory. the script has some error handle before the Population. and at every step if a wrong Data or an unknown Datatype is met, an E-mail will be sent.

findings.title: Possible hard-coded credential
findings.description: A credential-like variable appears to be assigned a literal value. Review the source; the matched value is redacted.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Invoke-SqlCommand' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
